getPrice(address).details: VIEW-only: reads the last committed price from storage.         For Chainlink: call updatePrice() (keeper path) before relying on this for         freshness. For MockPriceOracle: always current. LendingPool calls this via         staticcall so all implementations MUST be view-compatible (no state writes).

getPrice(address).notice: Returns the USD price of `asset`, scaled to 1e18.

isHealthy(address).notice: Returns true if the oracle for `asset` is healthy (not stale, not paused).
